⚠️Important⚠️

Please read this if you believe confidence can be rebuilt from zero 🙏

1. I feel very insecure about my appearance, especially my teeth which are slightly out or forward. Because of this, I always feel like people are silently judging me or making fun of me. It has affected my confidence badly.


2. I believe I look ugly or weird, so I try to avoid attention. I never look at girls in my class or interact with them because I think they’ll think negatively about me.


3. When I enter the classroom, I quietly go and sit at the back. I avoid eye contact with anyone, especially girls, and I overthink what others might be saying about me. Because of all this, I can't even focus on what’s being taught.


4. I’ve become extremely serious over time. Even when I feel like laughing or having fun, I stop myself. I laugh quietly, only when I’m with someone close, so others won’t notice my teeth or expressions.


5. I feel ashamed even in public or family events. I stay away from everyone and keep doing awkward things like folding my hands, changing posture, or avoiding eye contact — just so people don’t say anything or judge me.


6. I have a few friends, but even they sometimes troll me or ignore me. I don’t know how to start conversations, so I just stand there silently even when I want to talk.


7. One of my friends is open with everyone — he talks to people of all ages, and everyone likes him. I wish I could be like that too, but I don’t know how to open up the same way.


8. My voice isn’t deep, I’m thin, I don’t have a good face or body — and all of this makes me believe I’m not worthy of attention or friendship. I don’t feel confident about myself at all.


9. Sometimes when I see attractive girls on the road or in public, I stare without realizing, and later I feel bad or guilty. I know this is wrong, but I can’t control my mind at times.


10. Even with my close friends, I feel like I get left out. They talk to others about private stuff or relationships but not with me. It makes me feel ignored and unwanted.


11. I overthink everything. I don’t know how to talk to boys, forget about talking to girls. I always feel like I’m the only one who is different or not good enough.




---

🧠 I don’t know how to break out of this mindset.
💬 I want to talk to people freely.
🙂 I want to smile, laugh, be confident, and just be myself without shame.

But right now, I feel stuck, and I just want someone to understand what I’m going through.
Thank you sister. It was much needed ❤️🧿❤️

I was actually looking for such deep clarity content related career.

I wanna give me permission to explore as my life experiences are quite similar to you 😅

Highlights: 
1. Stop visualising your life at the beginning of your career, it's important to keep your vision clear, but over thinking doesn't help in life, instead it will create unrealistic  expectations. Observe right people for sometime in beginning to understand what excites you. Understanding what you need before you actually start is very important. Reach out to people to understand what excites you, wait until your vision sits right, dream your life but don't do it way too early. Have the courage to experiment in the beginnings. Have the attitude of mediocrity at the beginning to understand what may work well. 
2. Don't follow your passion blindly, start thinking it right. Your passion should drive what you need like, money. If your passion isn't yielding what you need in life in the long run, it will start to drain your energy.  Thinking it right is very important than following your passion blindly. Don't get stuck while chasing your dream. Your dream must be meaningful and yield good outcome.
3. Follow your flow, along with the outcome it's also important if you enjoying it. You can't stick to something for long run if you don't get excited with it. 
4. Don't look for the perfect Job, career isn't just the label. Don't get fantasized by the designation, ask yourself if will enjoy the job while to do that. Know what you like than chasing what everyone's are into it. Don't let your dream job drain you in the long run. We must have that works in real life. 
5. Follow the 'jealousy compass', when you like something on someone, know what you like. Understanding what's making the impact on you when you feel jealousy on seeing others, that's when helps you understand what you like. Catch those emotional signal. 
6. Use human design to understand what works best for you, your astrology tells you what works best on you. Explore how you are designed in this birth. Understand the line of work you're more suited for.
7. Three yeart pivot test, understand every chapter of your life, if the job no longer suits you and you made no growth in them then jump to the right career no matter what she you're in.
